versions.content: The function Ea_SetMode shall check if the module state is MEMIF_IDLE or MEMIF_BUSY_INTERNAL. If this is the case the module shall accept the mode change request. The mode change shall be executed asynchronously in the module's main function as soon as the module has finished the internal management operation.
